blockers.message: the review record has no `## plan.challenge` section, while roles were active at it
R-ops-1 (Payment call has no timeout) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-ops-2 (Unbounded retry of a non-idempotent charge, without backoff) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it
R-ops-3 (Charge failures are swallowed with no log or metric) is high and still open; fix it, or a human accepts the risk or defers it

findings.recommendation: Pass an explicit `timeout=` (connect and read, read from configuration) to `requests.post`, so a provider that stops answering fails the call instead of hanging the checkout worker forever.
findings.title: Payment call has no timeout

findings.recommendation: Bound the retries (a small maximum, exponential backoff with jitter), retry only transient failures (connection errors, timeouts, 5xx/429, never a 4xx such as a declined card), and send an idempotency key derived from the order id so a retry after a lost response cannot charge the customer twice; raise once the attempts are exhausted.
findings.title: Unbounded retry of a non-idempotent charge, without backoff

findings.recommendation: Log each failed attempt as structured fields (order_id, attempt, HTTP status, error type — never the payload's secrets), count attempts and failures in a metric, and surface a final actionable error naming the order when retries are exhausted, so an operator can see a stuck or failing charge.
findings.title: Charge failures are swallowed with no log or metric

findings.recommendation: Read the provider URL from the environment or configuration, so sandbox and production can be switched, and the endpoint changed, without a new release.
findings.title: Provider URL is hard-coded

findings.recommendation: Guard automatic charging behind a configuration flag so operators can fall back to manual charging in the provider's dashboard without redeploying; if a redeploy of the previous version is the accepted rollback, record it in the plan.
findings.title: No switch to turn automatic charging off
